Critics Consensus Flirting with complex themes, The Drama walks a tonal tightrope with impressive poise thanks to career-highlight performances by Robert Pattinson and Zendaya. Read Critics Reviews Audience Says Elevated by remarkable performances, The Drama wrestles with questions of trust and forgiveness, drawing out profoundly uncomfortable emotions that linger long after the credits roll. Read Audience Reviews Scott Tobias The Reveal 2d A compelling high-wire act, wonky at times yet committed to living in discomfort. Go to Full Review David Sims The Atlantic Apr 8 In The Drama, Pattinson embodies Charlie as the model of tame, harmless Brit charm, and the minute the actor has built his character up, he clearly takes perverse delight in unraveling him. Go to Full Review Tre'vell Anderson Pop Culture Happy Hour (NPR Podcast) Apr 7 To see how they play with the comedy and the dark element of the comedy, I really liked it. It kept me interested in what was coming next. Go to Full Review Kathleen Newman-Bremang Refinery29 8h As a twisted dark comedy about forgiveness, the price of radical honesty, and the limits of unconditional love, The Drama works. As a romance, it leaves a lot to be desired. Go to Full Review Sebastian Zavala Kahn Cinencuentro 22h By addressing a sensitive and potentially controversial topic through a narrative full of unexpected twists, the film prompts viewers to have interesting post-screening conversations. [Full review in Spanish]. Go to Full Review Keith Garlington Keith & the Movies 1d it’s hard not to lose yourself in the messiness…. That’s because Borgli views it through an honest and incisive lens while the formidable performances from Zendaya and Pattinson is the glue that holds it all together. Go to Full Review Read all reviews Dom 4h I wish there was more to the plot it seemed very rushed chrisc 7h I enjoyed all the acting and direction. I just didn’t like the dark subject matter. David S 9h Kinda slow, not something I can recommend Erica H 10h Movie was horrible , so slow. Storyline made no sense, kept jumping. Both Zendaya and Robert’s worst performance. Waste of money See more gloria v 12h The movie was very cringey. Zendaya and Robert Pattinson didnt look good as a couple. The movie just induced lots of confusion and even a little anger. Would not recommend. The actors acted great but the storyline was not the best See more Cristina A 13h Only gets 1 star for Zendaya - was angry for most of the film at Charlie and Rachel and felt horrible for her character of Emma. Avoid.
